name: devin-bundle
description: Devin-focused export bundle: skills I use + consolidated rules. Cross-platform installer. Absorbed mattpocock/skills engineering + productivity sets with unified overlapping skills.

skills.name: tool-and-skill-discovery
skills.purpose: Meta-skill: discover and invoke the right skill/tool for any task

skills.name: graphify
skills.purpose: Turn any input into a persistent knowledge graph; query with /graphify

skills.name: git-helper
skills.purpose: Git workflow assistance, branch management, commit messages

skills.name: gh
skills.purpose: Patterns for invoking the GitHub CLI (gh) from agents

skills.name: find-skills
skills.purpose: Discover and install agent skills when none match

skills.name: self-extend
skills.purpose: Self-iteration: create tools, hooks, and skills to evolve capabilities

skills.name: systematic-debugging
skills.purpose: Structured debugging: reproduce, trace, isolate root cause before fixing

skills.name: using-superpowers
skills.purpose: Establishes how to find and use skills; skill invocation before any response

skills.name: writing-plans
skills.purpose: Write a plan from a spec before touching code

skills.name: context7
skills.purpose: Retrieve up-to-date library/framework documentation via Context7 API

skills.name: memory-bridge
skills.purpose: Browse and compare wiki knowledge by which AI tool produced it

skills.name: tdd
skills.purpose: Test-driven development. Unified: iron-law discipline (test first, watch fail, minimal code) + seams-first operational approach (agree test boundaries, vertical slices, anti-patterns). Decision logic for when to use which.

skills.name: code-review
skills.purpose: Review code changes on two axes (Standards vs Spec) with parallel sub-agents. Unified: subagent-dispatch workflow + two-axis methodology + Fowler code smell baseline. Decision logic for when to use which.

skills.name: grilling
skills.purpose: Explore and stress-test ideas before implementation. Unified: collaborative brainstorming (one question at a time, visual companion, design doc) + relentless grilling (design tree, frontier rounds, numbered questions). Decision logic for when to use which.

skills.name: diagnosing-bugs
skills.purpose: Disciplined diagnosis loop: build feedback loop that goes red -> minimise -> hypothesise -> instrument -> fix -> regression-test

skills.name: research
skills.purpose: Investigate a question against high-trust primary sources, capture findings as cited Markdown

skills.name: prototype
skills.purpose: Build a throwaway prototype to answer a design question: single HTML file or toggleable UI variations

skills.name: domain-modeling
skills.purpose: Domain modeling with CONTEXT.md and ADRs

skills.name: codebase-design
skills.purpose: Codebase design vocabulary: modules, interfaces, depth, seams, adapters, leverage, locality

skills.name: improve-codebase-architecture
skills.purpose: Scan codebase for deepening opportunities, present as visual HTML report, then grill through chosen one

skills.name: resolving-merge-conflicts
skills.purpose: Resolve merge conflicts systematically

skills.name: to-spec
skills.purpose: Turn current conversation into a spec and publish to issue tracker

skills.name: to-tickets
skills.purpose: Break any plan, spec, or conversation into tracer-bullet tickets with blocking edges

skills.name: wayfinder
skills.purpose: Plan huge work as a shared map of decision tickets on the issue tracker, resolved one at a time

skills.name: implement
skills.purpose: Build work described by spec or tickets, driving /tdd at pre-agreed seams, closing with /code-review

skills.name: grill-with-docs
skills.purpose: Grilling session that also builds project domain model, sharpening terminology and updating CONTEXT.md and ADRs

skills.name: wizard
skills.purpose: Generate interactive bash wizard that walks a human through manual steps (infra provisioning, credentials, CI secrets)

skills.name: handoff
skills.purpose: Compact current conversation into a handoff document so another agent can continue the work

skills.name: teach
skills.purpose: Teach user a new skill or concept over multiple sessions, using current directory as stateful teaching workspace

skills.name: writing-for-agents
skills.purpose: Writing documents for agents: skills, AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md, and any doc an agent reaches by a pointer

skills.name: wait-what
skills.purpose: Re-pitch a message that didn't land, in plain English, using CONTEXT.md vocabulary

skills.name: to-questionnaire
skills.purpose: Turn a decision you can't answer alone into a Markdown questionnaire for the person who can

skills.name: mutation-testing
skills.purpose: Find gaps in test coverage via mutation testing. 4-stage process: discovery, validation (local first, CI optional), production cross-reference (optional), risk assessment. CI-agnostic.

skills.name: debug-ci-failures
skills.purpose: Debug CI build failures systematically. CI-agnostic: works with GitHub Actions, CircleCI, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or any CI. Integrates with systematic-debugging and diagnosing-bugs.

skills.name: subagent-driven-development
skills.purpose: Execute implementation plans by dispatching a fresh implementer subagent per task, task review after each (spec + quality), broad final review. Coordinator never implements directly — preserves context for coordination. Has implementer/task-reviewer/re-review prompt templates + scripts.

skills.name: obsidian-project-docs
skills.purpose: Document software projects in Obsidian as SRS/ISO-style engineering wiki. Scaffolds notes, Bases for modules/functions/dependencies/config, and Canvas architecture diagrams. Integrates with graphify, domain-modeling, and codebase-design.

skills.name: dispatching-parallel-agents
skills.purpose: Dispatch one subagent per independent problem domain (e.g. 3 test files failing with different root causes). Parallel dispatch in a single message. Review and integrate when all return.

skills.name: executing-plans
skills.purpose: Fallback for executing implementation plans when subagents are NOT available. Load plan, review critically, execute tasks in sequence with checkpoints, finish with finishing-a-development-branch.

skills.name: finishing-a-development-branch
skills.purpose: Final step of plan execution: verify all tests pass, present options (merge, PR, keep branch), execute chosen option. Used by subagent-driven-development and executing-plans.

skills.name: receiving-code-review
skills.purpose: How to handle incoming code review feedback: verify before implementing, push back with technical reasoning when wrong, no performative agreement. Complements code-review (which covers requesting + giving review).

skills.name: using-git-worktrees
skills.purpose: Create isolated git worktrees for parallel work branches. Used by executing-plans and subagent-driven-development for workspace isolation.

skills.name: verification-before-completion
skills.purpose: Iron law: NO COMPLETION CLAIMS WITHOUT FRESH VERIFICATION EVIDENCE. Gate function: identify command, run it, read output, verify, only then claim. Complements rule 6 (inner-loop validation) with enforcement discipline.

skills.name: writing-skills
skills.purpose: Meta-skill: how to write agent skills using TDD approach. RED (baseline test without skill), GREEN (write minimal skill), REFACTOR (close loopholes). Includes bulletproofing against rationalization, testing with subagents, persuasion principles. Complements self-extend (the why) with the how.
